svg.title: Tempo, a workout log your AI can read
svg.desc: Tempo’s volume panel on sample data: 140 sets, 1,040 reps and 71,605 kg, then eight movements ranked by sets in orange bars, from bench press at 24 sets to Romanian deadlift at 12. Below it, the landing page’s sample chat, where Claude answers what was benched last Tuesday and whether it was a record.
